title: Audited Override and Continue
scope: Implemented explicit, auditable safe advisory overrides in the active Build 51 measurement workflow without unrelated redesign, data, or architecture work.
objectives: Preserve abnormal entered measurements and explain advisory warnings and recommended rechecks.
Require deliberate Override & Continue action for safe advisory warnings across Beginner, Seasoned, Pro, and compatible Novice guidance.
Persist complete override evidence with the correct job/workflow and expose it in Tune Log/audit history.
Keep genuine hard stops non-overridable and regression-test all required behavior at browser level.
constraints: Vehicle data and unrelated architecture/features remain unchanged.
Abnormal values, specifications, recommendations, and warning position remain distinct and unmodified.
Existing localStorage jobs and Novice compatibility are preserved.
AFR remains optional without an installed wideband sensor.

acceptanceTests.expected: All 20 audited override acceptance requirements pass through actual browser behavior.
acceptanceTests.evidence: tests/validate-workflow.cjs adds 34 browser assertions within a 126-assertion workflow run, covering warning/value/action/audit/context/persistence/history/in-range/hard-stop/guidance/Novice/AFR/phone UX behavior.

acceptanceTests.expected: Baseline and two final post-change npm run validate runs exit zero.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Baseline passed 5 programs/92 assertions; two final post-change runs each passed 5 programs/126 assertions; GitHub Actions run 33353156503 succeeded.
git diff --exit-code confirmed data/vehicle-applications.js unchanged from baseline.

implementationNotes: Added backward-compatible workflow.overrideAudit normalization and structured WARNING_OVERRIDE records.
Classified plausible out-of-working-range readings as safe advisories and technically implausible readings as non-overridable hard stops.
Added deliberate Correct / Recheck and Override & Continue controls with guidance-specific copy and optional technician reason.
Mirrored override evidence into Tune Log history without altering the original measurement, specifications, or recommendations.
Resolved B-0052-03 and automated CARB-004 with actual browser behavior.

validation.summary: Baseline passed all 5 programs/92 workflow assertions. Two required final local runs each passed all 5 programs/126 workflow assertions. GitHub Actions run 33353156503 passed for the implementation SHA.
